description: Main application component for recipe explorer, managing state, data fetching, filtering, and rendering child components.

methods.name: App
methods.description: React functional component defining the main app logic and UI.

methods.name: loadInitial
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch initial data for recipes, cuisines, ingredients, and favorites.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Function to add or remove a recipe from favorites, updating local storage.

methods.name: openRecipeDetail
methods.description: Sets the selected recipe to display its details.

methods.name: closeRecipeDetail
methods.description: Clears the selected recipe to close the detail modal.
